cohort: 57 term infants from a randomized clinical trial in 2013 studying the safety of Agave fructans in newborns
finding: Infants born by C-section had lower levels of Bacteroidetes, higher levels of Firmicutes, and a higher Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes ratio compared to infants born vaginally.
mod_finding: The gut microbiota profile associated with C-section delivery in Mexican infants may contribute to the obesity epidemic in Mexico.
